Solvent Reservoirs.name: Polyethylene
Solvent Reservoirs.reasoning: Common polymer used for solvent reservoirs due to chemical resistance and durability; standard material with few substitutes in this application.

Solvent Reservoirs.name: Polypropylene
Solvent Reservoirs.reasoning: Widely used plastic in chemical containers for solvent compatibility and mechanical strength; often used alongside polyethylene.

Pump Module.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Pump Module.reasoning: Essential for wetted parts of pump ensuring corrosion resistance and mechanical strength in HPLC pumps; industry standard with minor alternatives.

Pump Module.name: Ceramic
Pump Module.reasoning: Used for pump seals and plungers due to hardness and wear resistance; common but some designs may use alternatives.

Pump Module.name: PTFE
Pump Module.reasoning: Critical for chemically resistant sealings and tubing within the pump module; widely used and reliable material.

Injector/Autosampler.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Injector/Autosampler.reasoning: Used for injector valves and needles for corrosion resistance and mechanical durability; standard in the industry.

Injector/Autosampler.name: Polypropylene
Injector/Autosampler.reasoning: Common for housing components and sample vials; good chemical resistance though alternatives like polyethylene exist.

Injector/Autosampler.name: Glass
Injector/Autosampler.reasoning: May be used in sample vials or optical components if applicable; alternatives exist but glass is standard for chemical stability.

Chromatographic Column.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Chromatographic Column.reasoning: Primary structural material for high-pressure columns due to strength and corrosion resistance; industry standard.

Chromatographic Column.name: C18 silica
Chromatographic Column.reasoning: Widely used stationary phase material for reversed-phase chromatography columns; essential for separation functionality.

Chromatographic Column.name: PTFE
Chromatographic Column.reasoning: Used in internal linings and seals to ensure solvent resistance; alternatives exist but PTFE is preferred.

Detector Module.name: Silicon
Detector Module.reasoning: Used in photodiode detectors for UV/Vis detection with excellent semiconductor properties; standard material.

Detector Module.name: Glass
Detector Module.reasoning: Optical windows and lenses are commonly made from glass for transparency and chemical durability.

Detector Module.name: Aluminum
Detector Module.reasoning: Used in structural housings and heat sinks; alternatives exist but aluminum is lightweight and thermally conductive.

Detector Module.name: Indium gallium arsenide
Detector Module.reasoning: Used in some specialized detectors especially for near-infrared detection; not universal but important in some models.

Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.name: Silicon
Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.reasoning: Core semiconductor material for integrated circuits and processors; universally essential.

Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.name: Copper
Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.reasoning: Primary conductor material in circuit boards and wiring due to excellent electrical conductivity; industry standard.

Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.name: Aluminum
Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.reasoning: Used in heat sinks and structural parts; lighter alternative to steel, common but not always essential.

Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.name: Epoxy resins
Data Acquisition and Control Electronics.reasoning: Used as PCB laminates and protective coatings; extensively used in electronics manufacturing.

Waste Container.name: Polyethylene
Waste Container.reasoning: Standard chemically resistant polymer for waste containers handling solvents; widely used with few substitutes.

Waste Container.name: Polypropylene
Waste Container.reasoning: Also common for chemical container housings providing chemical resistance and strength.

Tubing and Connectors.name: PTFE
Tubing and Connectors.reasoning: Gold standard tubing material for HPLC due to excellent chemical inertness and pressure resistance.

Tubing and Connectors.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Tubing and Connectors.reasoning: Used for connectors and high-pressure tubing sections; industry standard for corrosion resistance and strength.
